# M2 clock-domain budgets. CMOS 100 MHz is inherited timing budget, not measured PCLK.



set_max_delay -from [get_clocks {core_clk}] -to [get_clocks {clk_sys}] 4.5



set_max_delay -from [get_clocks {clk_sys}] -to [get_clocks {core_clk}] 4.5







# sys/core/DDR share PLL reference: 10.416=2*5.208=4*2.604 ns.



# Conservative common precision avoids false 1 ps relationships from independent rounding.







# M3.1: asynchronous keys only to the first synchronizer D pin.



set key0_meta_d [get_pins -regexp {^u_shape_system/u_controls/key_meta\[0\]~FF\|D$}]



set key1_meta_d [get_pins -regexp {^u_shape_system/u_controls/key_meta\[1\]~FF\|D$}]



if {[llength $key0_meta_d] != 1 || [llength $key1_meta_d] != 1} {error "M31 first-stage pin match is not exactly one per key"}



set_false_path -from [get_ports {key_n[0]}] -to $key0_meta_d



set_false_path -from [get_ports {key_n[1]}] -to $key1_meta_d



puts "M31_KEY_EXCEPTION_PINS $key0_meta_d $key1_meta_d"







# Standalone foreground-only exact CDC. Values and retained physical boundary semantics unchanged.
proc shape_exact {selectors label} {
 set combined [list]
 foreach selector $selectors {
  set found [get_pins -regexp $selector]
  if {[llength $found] != 1} {error "STANDALONE_SELECTOR_NOT_SINGLETON $label $selector count=[llength $found]"}
  foreach pin $found {lappend combined $pin}
 }
 if {[llength $combined] != [llength $selectors]} {error "STANDALONE_SELECTOR_COUNT $label"}
 return [join $combined " "]
}
set m5b1_video_camera_fifo_rgs1_source [shape_exact {
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[0\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[1\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[2\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[3\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[4\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[5\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[6\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[7\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rg\[8\]\~FF\|CLK$}
 {^u_shape_system/u_m5b1/video/camera_fifo/rp\[0\]\~FF\|CLK$}
